summary: Braintrust's free Starter plan ($0 / month, no credit card required) includes $10 in model credits each month. Monthly model credits cover built-in models, which you can use without providing your own API key, as well as AI features like Topics. Unused credits do not roll over. On Starter, the organization needs at least one owner with a work email address, or a payment method on file, to access built-in models. Calling built-in models directly through the gateway requires a Pro or Enterprise plan. If credits are exhausted and on-demand usage is not enabled, built-in model usage pauses until the next monthly cycle or until a card is added.
claim_steps: Sign up for Braintrust on the free Starter plan (no credit card required)
Make sure at least one organization owner uses a work email address (or add a payment method) to unlock built-in models
Use built-in models and Topics; $10 in credits applies each month and unused credits do not roll over
